cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: Let us Recite (1) When the gong sounds ten in the morning and I walk to school by our lane, Every day I meet the hawker crying, “Bangles, crystal bangles!” There is nothing to hurry him on, there is no road he must take, no place he must go to, no time when he must come home.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: I wish I were a hawker, spending my day in the road, crying, “Bangles, crystal bangles!” 9 Vocation Unit 5: Work is Worship Chapter 9.indd 105 6/10/2025 4:37:17 PM (2) When at four in the afternoon I come back from the school.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: I can see through the gate of that house the gardener digging the ground.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: He does what he likes with his spade, he soils his clothes with dust, nobody takes him to task if he gets baked in the sun or gets wet.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: I wish I were a gardener digging away at the garden with nobody to stop me from digging.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Vocation'?
cards.back: The lane is dark and lonely, and the street-lamp stands like a giant with one red eye in its head.
